text:
marta-partnerships: Quick sync thread to lock down the marketplace onboarding checklist we discussed offline. Focus areas: publisher account IDs, least-priv IAM, KMS cross-account policy for private offers, SKU naming + SLA blurbs, and a simple pilot plan. Keep notes short.

ishaan-cloud: I can gather publisher IDs and minimal IAM role templates. Heads-up: GCP wants a publisher service account and billing role; AWS expects a marketplace-publish role with sts:AssumeRole.

claire-legal: I'll draft the EU data-residency opt-out, the KMS consent phrasing, and a short telemetry clause. Need to know whether customer prompts are ever persisted in support logs (yes/no).

derek-product: SKU thoughts: "starter" (metered, free trial), "scale" (token-metered), "enterprise" (reserved + SLA + SI add-on). Also propose an "integration" SKU for SI/hardware partners. Trial durations: 7/14/30 respectively.

anuj-ops: Private-offer requirements: customer KMS key ARN, cross-account key policy, and published support contact for key rotation. For Azure private offers we also need customer subscription consent. I'll prepare a Terraform snippet and sample key policy.

storefront-bot: Reminder: uploads will fail if support email missing or logo assets are under recommended size (1024x1024). Validator returns codes in this channel.

ishaan-cloud: Draft IAM snippet (AWS assume-role example):

```
# AWS minimal role for marketplace publishing
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/aws-marketplace-publish"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

anuj-ops: And a KMS cross-account policy example for the customer's key (snippet):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowMarketplaceUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::OUR_PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/aws-marketplace-run"]},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

claire-legal: Regarding logs: default is aggregated metrics only. We do NOT persist raw prompts unless a tenant opts into "support-debug"; I'll add that opt-in language and retention limits. Also will flag the MSA requirement for Azure private offers.

derek-product: SLA blurbs draft: "Enterprise SKU: 99.9% API availability; median latency <200ms for small models; dedicated capacity available as add-on." Legal, please sanity-check.

claire-legal: Good start. I'll tweak to avoid hard guarantees about model latency and instead offer "target latency" language with fallback clauses. Also need to confirm any refund/credit mechanics.

marta-partnerships: Action items and owners:
- Publisher Account IDs + IAM templates: ishaan-cloud
- KMS cross-account policy + Terraform snippet: anuj-ops
- Legal copy (KMS consent, residency opt-out, telemetry opt-in): claire-legal
- SKU json + pricing unit definitions + SLA text: derek-product
- Preflight assets checklist + sandbox upload coordination: marta-partnerships

ishaan-cloud: ETA: publisher IDs and IAM templates by Tue EOD.

anuj-ops: ETA Terraform + key policy by Wed. I'll include a sample VPC networking note for private offers.

claire-legal: I'll post drafts by Tue morning; flagging translation needs for FR/DE if we publish EU text to the marketplace.

derek-product: I'll produce a pricing.json with units (token-unit vs inference-hour) and recommend mapping guidance for billing teams by Wed. Quick ask to eng: token vs RU preference?

storefront-bot: Validator note: missing support contact -> failure code MF-002; missing logo -> MF-003.

marta-partnerships: Proposed pilot timeline: collect artifacts by Wed, run preflight Thurs in sandbox, fix failures Thurs afternoon, and target a small partner pilot on Mon. Sync Wed 9am PT to walk documents. I'll drop a calendar invite.

ishaan-cloud: I'll add publisher accounts to the shared drive today and include minimal IAM perms.

anuj-ops: I'll push the terraform snippet and example key policy to the drive and link here when done.

claire-legal: Drafts will be in the drive by Tue AM.

storefront-bot: After sandbox upload validator will post any schema errors here. Use tag #manifest-error for follow-ups.

marta-partnerships: Thanks everyone — short and actionable. If a hardware partner lead wants to be looped into the pilot for an on-prem appliance SKU, reply here and I'll invite them. :rocket:
